objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and linked to other artifacts in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Includes document type abbreviation, consecutive 4-digit number per type, and title by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Part of the default document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in workflow status reports.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader user groups.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity period is calculated.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid-until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date by which validity expires.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later changes affect e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later changes affect workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document and used for templates, numbering, validity periods, and archive duration.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration defined for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created during release, revision, reactivation, or content and property changes.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator, creator, recipient, or workflow participant.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented to provide appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned to documents for authorizations, distribution, reader access, archive access, or administrative permissions.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked with documents by database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked with documents by database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked with documents by database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that can be linked with documents by database integration.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data that can be linked with documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment added to a document, released and published directly via properties, not subject to the release cycle of the main document, and deletable directly.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a document and automatically released with the main document, with its own versioning and release-process statuses.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for a selected released document to invalidate and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task completed by workflow participants during release, review, approval, acknowledgement, validity extension, override, or reactivation.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document by assigning user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons or users in assigned groups for a released document.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, document release, change proposals, validity extension, override, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled from distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of released document content that must be checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when attaching a new document object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations via document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an Additional Info object to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment object to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark released attachments for archiving.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A participant rejects during review or release and the workflow is canceled for subsequent participants.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document the signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, causing creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Create a new version of a document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents or attachments by withdrawing authorizations rather than physical deletion.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: inform_document_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the validity extension request with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised document version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and give the last valid approved version the status Out of force.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke rights at user group and person level except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an invalidated document by creating a new version and restoring metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Notify the author team when all maintained persons in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards from distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate and search documents using role-specific reports and selection parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check a translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release a translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to an existing document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.
